fusions.name: Tail Whip
fusions.desc: Whips a scaled tail into the target, dealing 12 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Basking Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a glob that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and hinders its attacks for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Regrown Scale
fusions.desc: Regrows damaged plates, restoring 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Basking Hide
fusions.desc: In daylight, your armour rises by 12%.
